Question B-007-007-009.

Why the correct answer is right: Auroral paths can badly distort audio, but simple on-off keyed CW elements can still be recognized through rough propagation.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "CW, because it resists fading": CW, because it resists fading names the right emission but the wrong reason; CW is favoured mainly because it remains readable when distorted.
- sourceIndex 2: "FM, because it is readable even when distorted": FM, because it is readable even when distorted is wrong because FM voice usually suffers badly on auroral paths.
- sourceIndex 3: "FM, because it resists fading": FM, because it resists fading is wrong both in mode choice and in the stated reason for auroral reliability.
